sheets.prompt: Creature and plant design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the flora and fauna of a twilight swamp that hums and the deep wood north of it, drawn like a naturalist's plate on a plain cream background, each one small and clearly separated: a tall stilt fungus on thin legs, its cap faintly glowing; a cluster of organ pipe plants standing in water; an eye bulb, a stalk ending in a glowing round eye; a swamp fan; spore puffs on the ground; a glowing lantern pod tree; a candelabra plant; coral fingers; a velvet trumpet flower; shelf bracket fungi; a feather plume; a lilac eye-moth with eye spots on its wings, one splitting into three little moths that scatter; a violet spore shell, one popped open into a spray of glowing spores; a coral lantern fish leaping from one pool to another; a pale lantern grub, one gone dark leaving only two blinking eyes. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade glass fluid backpack stands at one side for scale. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, violet, swamp green, teal and lime glows, peach-orange, dark teal and lilac, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
